intro: Clear thinking. Useful answers. Tell me what you’re working on.

faqs.question: How much experience does Hadi Hassan have?
faqs.answer: Hadi Hassan has over ten years of experience across brand identity, digital experiences and video production. He is based in Lahore, Pakistan and is founder of INTELLIGNCE.

faqs.question: Tell me about Morganics.
faqs.answer: Morganics is Hadi Hassan’s brand identity and packaging project. The work connects brand positioning and audience guidelines with a botanical M monogram, English and Urdu wordmarks, colour and typography systems, jar/pouch/box packaging, printed collateral and product campaign visuals. Each product keeps its own character while belonging to a shared brand family. Case study: https://hadi.intellignce.net/morganics/. Do not invent sales, revenue or performance results.

faqs.question: What can you help with?
faqs.answer: Hadi works across brand identity, graphic and UI/UX design, social creatives, e-commerce, SaaS and app development, and landing pages. Share your goal and we can find the closest fit.

faqs.question: Can you create a brand identity?
faqs.answer: Yes. Branding can cover logo design, visual identity, brand guidelines, packaging and research. The scope depends on where your business is today and what you need to launch or improve.

faqs.question: Do you offer design and UI/UX?
faqs.answer: Design support includes websites and apps, pitch decks, presentations, print collateral and social graphics. Tell me the format, quantity and intended audience.

faqs.question: Can you help with social content?
faqs.answer: Social support includes static visuals, carousels, videos and reels, content strategy, and campaign concepts and execution. The right mix depends on your platforms, goals and monthly volume.

faqs.question: Do you work on online stores?
faqs.answer: E-commerce support includes platform setup, store design, product photography, product pages and copywriting. Let’s clarify what you sell, your platform and the main challenge.

faqs.question: Can you help with an app or SaaS?
faqs.answer: Application work can include product UI/UX, web and SaaS development, mobile applications and integrations. Share the problem, users and three most important features so Hadi can review the scope.

faqs.question: Can you create a landing page?
faqs.answer: Landing pages focus on a clear offer, useful content and a meaningful action such as an enquiry, booking or signup. Share your offer, traffic source and available assets.

faqs.question: How much will my project cost?
faqs.answer: A project quote needs a defined scope, deliverables and timeline. I can help prepare that brief for Hadi. Any budget ranges in the consultation are planning ranges, not a confirmed price.

faqs.question: Can I book a call?
faqs.answer: Use the website’s booking flow for a 30-minute conversation with Hadi. It checks live availability before confirmation. A time is reserved only after the booking is confirmed.

faqs.question: I’d like to speak with Hadi.
faqs.answer: You can email hadi@intellignce.net, open WhatsApp, or prepare a project enquiry. WhatsApp opens your app with a draft; you choose whether to send it.

faqs.question: Where can I see the work?
faqs.answer: The case-study archive includes brand identities, packaging, digital design, campaigns, photography and motion work. Choose a relevant example, then discuss what your own project needs.

faqs.question: How long will it take?
faqs.answer: Timelines depend on scope, supplied assets, feedback and availability. Share your target date in the brief. Hadi will confirm feasibility; this assistant cannot promise a delivery date.
